FailureReason.description: Why a receipt is FAILED, in words a person can act on (no error text).
FailureReason.title: FailureReason

FieldSource.description: Where a product's name, brand, size, category or tags came from (ADR-0018).
FieldSource.title: FieldSource

LineItemOut.description: ``product_name`` and ``product_category`` are the linked product's, if any.
LineItemOut.title: LineItemOut

LineKind.description:
What a receipt line is. Only DISCOUNT lines, and a DEPOSIT returned, carry negative
totals.
LineKind.title: LineKind

MatchSource.description: How a line was linked to its product, in matching order (PLAN 6).
MatchSource.title: MatchSource

MonthSummaryOut.description:
A month's completed receipts by purchase date: ``spent`` and ``saved`` one sum per
currency (``saved`` in ``spent``'s order), ``trips`` the receipts, ``weeks`` the 1st-7th,
8th-14th, 15th-21st and 22nd-end, ``stores`` one row per store and currency, largest first.
``open_reviews``, ``unconfirmed_products``, ``processing`` and ``recent`` (the newest
receipts of any month and status) describe the app now, whatever the month.
MonthSummaryOut.title: MonthSummaryOut

PricePointOut.description:
One dated purchase for a price trend: ``paid`` for ``quantity`` of ``unit`` (null:
unknown, compared as each).
PricePointOut.title: PricePointOut

ProcessingStage.description: Where a receipt is in the pipeline; reported live from Stage 2 (SSE).
ProcessingStage.title: ProcessingStage

ProductConfirmIn.description:
The fields to confirm (missing or null: every filled field) and, per field, the value
the person saw (``size`` as ``24 each``, null when empty); a stored value that differs
refuses the confirmation.
ProductConfirmIn.title: ProductConfirmIn

ProductMergeIn.description: The product the merged one is the same as: it is kept, the merged one is deleted.
ProductMergeIn.title: ProductMergeIn

ProductOut.description:
``field_sources`` maps each stamped field (``canonical_name``, ``brand``, ``size``,
``category``, ``tags``) to where it came from; ``llm`` is a guess to show as suggested.
``confirmed``: a person or a product database named it.
ProductOut.title: ProductOut

ProductPurchaseOut.description:
One purchase of a product: ``unit_price`` is the regular price of one ``unit`` (null:
unknown, compared as each), ``discount`` (<= 0) the line's linked discount and ``paid`` the
line total after it.
ProductPurchaseOut.title: ProductPurchaseOut

ProductSummaryOut.description:
A product as listed: ``times_bought`` counts its receipt lines, ``last_purchase`` is the
newest of them, ``recent`` the dated ones among its 12 newest, newest first.
ProductSummaryOut.title: ProductSummaryOut

ProductToCheckOut.description:
A bought product nobody has confirmed yet: ``raw_text`` is its earliest receipt line as
printed, ``times_bought`` counts its receipt lines.
ProductToCheckOut.title: ProductToCheckOut

ProductUpdateIn.description:
The fields a person changed; a missing or null field is left as it is. ``size`` is text
like ``500 g``; an empty ``brand`` or ``size``, or no ``tags``, clears the field.
``expected`` is what the person saw, as for ``ProductConfirmIn``.
ProductUpdateIn.title: ProductUpdateIn

ReceiptMatchOut.description:
A receipt found by a search: ``lines`` are the descriptions of its lines that matched
(empty when only the store name did).
ReceiptMatchOut.title: ReceiptMatchOut

ReceiptSummaryOut.description:
``item_count`` counts the ITEM lines (not discounts, deposits or fees); ``savings``
(>= 0) is what the receipt's discount lines took off.
ReceiptSummaryOut.title: ReceiptSummaryOut

ResolveReviewIn.description:
Either ``accept`` (the extraction as read) or a corrected ``draft``. One that does not
add up is refused unless ``force`` is set with a ``reason``.
ResolveReviewIn.title: ResolveReviewIn

ReviewAnswerOut.description:
The receipt once the answer is queued: the worker saves it (poll GET
/api/receipts/{receipt_id}).
ReviewAnswerOut.title: ReviewAnswerOut

ReviewDraftBody.description:
A reading of the receipt, as the review shows it and as a person corrects it: amounts in
cents of ``currency``, lines in printed order.
ReviewDraftBody.title: ReviewDraftBody

ReviewIssueOut.description: Why the receipt waits for a person; ``position`` is the draft line it is about.
ReviewIssueOut.title: ReviewIssueOut

ReviewLineBody.description:
One line of a reading. ``applies_to`` is the index, in ``lines``, of the item a discount
belongs to.
ReviewLineBody.title: ReviewLineBody

ReviewOut.description:
One review: ``draft`` is the extraction to accept or correct (null when there is none
and the reading must be typed in); ``image_url`` serves the receipt's photo.
``answer_queued``: an answer is queued or running in the worker (answering again is a
409).
ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut

ReviewSummaryOut.description:
An open review as listed; ``reading`` is the extraction it holds, null when there is
none (the reading never parsed).
ReviewSummaryOut.title: ReviewSummaryOut

WeekSpendOut.description:
``start`` to ``end`` inclusive; ``spent`` one sum per currency, largest first (empty
when nothing was bought).
WeekSpendOut.title: WeekSpendOut

get.description: Every product category with its display label, in a stable order.
The process is up. Touches no database or other dependency.
Every component is usable. Answers 503 with the same body when one is not.

503.description: A component is not ready; the body says which and why.

get.description:
Every product with at least one receipt line, by name, each with how often it was
bought and its newest purchase.

Every bought product nobody has confirmed yet, most bought first, then the newest
purchase, then the product id; each with its earliest receipt line as printed.
One product with its field sources; an unknown id is a 404 problem.

patch.description:
Write the fields sent and stamp each ``person``; the others are kept. A stored value
that differs from its ``expected`` one is a 409 problem (nothing written); a blank name or
an unreadable size is a 422 problem, an unknown id a 404 problem.

post.description:
Accept the product's current values as the person's (every filled field stamped
``person``, or only the filled ``fields`` sent, the others' sources kept). A stored value
that differs from its ``expected`` one is a 409 problem (nothing written); an unknown id
a 404 problem.

The product is the same as ``into_id``: its purchases, prices, codes, aliases and
corrections move to that one, which takes each of its better-sourced fields, and it is
deleted. Returns the kept product. Only a backup undoes it. Merging a product into itself
is a 422 problem, an unknown id a 404 problem; while a receipt is being read, a 409
problem (nothing written).
post.summary: Merge a product into the same one

get.description:
Bought products that may be the same as this one: those sharing one of its codes first,
then those sharing a word of its name, best match first (at most 10); never the product
itself. An unknown id is a 404 problem.
get.summary: List products that may be the same one

get.description:
The product ``into_id`` as merging this one into it would leave it (its name, brand,
size, category and tags, each the better-sourced of the two); nothing is written. Merging
a product into itself is a 422 problem, an unknown id a 404 problem.
get.summary: Preview merging a product into the same one

get.description:
Every receipt line that bought the product, newest first (undated last), paid after
its discount; an unknown id is a 404 problem.

Receipts by purchase date, newest first (undated last, then newest recorded first). A bad
cursor or limit is a 422 problem.

200.description: The photo was uploaded before: its receipt, not processed again.

get.description:
One receipt with its lines (and the products they link to), an arithmetic report
computed from the current data, and the open review it waits for (``review_id``).

The receipt's stored photo (every photo is stored as a JPEG); a receipt without one, or
an unknown receipt, is a 404 problem.

post.description:
Queue a FAILED receipt for the worker again: it continues from where the run stopped, or
reads the stored photo again; poll GET /api/receipts/{id} for its status. A receipt that is
not FAILED, already queued, or has no stored photo is a 409 problem.

get.description:
The open reviews a person can answer now, newest first, whatever their receipt's
status; one whose answer is queued or running is left out.

One review with its issues, the reading it holds and its photo; an unknown id is a 404
problem.

post.description:
Accept the reading as read or save a corrected one; the worker resumes the receipt with
it. A reading that does not add up is a 422 problem of type /problems/inconsistent-receipt
listing each issue in ``errors``, unless ``force`` is set with a ``reason``. An unknown
review is a 404 problem; one already resolved, or already answered, a 409 problem.

get.description:
Products bought (name, brand, tag or category) and receipts (store name, or a line's
printed text, description or product), every word matching as a word prefix. Search syntax
is plain text. A query shorter than 2 or longer than 100 characters is a 422 problem.

Spending of the month's completed receipts by purchase date, by week and by store, plus
what is waiting now (open reviews, unconfirmed products, receipts being read) and the newest
receipts. A malformed month is a 422 problem.

parameters.description: YYYY-MM; the server's current month by default
parameters.name: month

schema.description: YYYY-MM; the server's current month by default
schema.title: Month
